review:
Arabian nights on 25 lines, with a massive mystery symbol and two bonuses: regular free spins, and Djinn Spins with pattern collect, upgrade and copy features.

Djinn Spins are the one to hope for, since those features can turn a grid around. Very high volatility, 25,000x cap, 96.07% RTP. Gorgeous art, but a game that asks for patience.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
